title: Torus and circular cross sections
section: Practice Test ▷ Question 26: surfaces of revolution
terms: torus; major radius; minor radius; solid torus; annular cross section.

exposition.text:
A ring torus is formed by revolving a circle of radius a about an axis in its plane whose distance
from the center is R > a. Here R is the major radius and a the minor radius. With the axis

condition R > a is essential for this ordinary ring-torus description; it keeps the generating

A useful surface parametrization is ((R + a cos v) cos u, (R + a cos v) sin u, a sin v) with both angles
running through a full period. Its area element is a(R + a cos v) du dv for R > a. It explains
the total area formula and permits partial-surface calculations that cannot be found by taking a
simple fraction of the total.
